config_keys.lane_actions: bool, default False. Search config key (search_config binding / record['search_config'] via niche_collect.validate). When absent or false: no lane key exists anywhere, no lane_plans import, byte-identical output.
config_keys.lane_rate: float 0..1, default 0.25. Exploration rate: probability one member of a sampled plan carries one lane-change attempt (search hyperparameter, NOT a safety rule; the acceleration analogue is the registered sigma=0.5).
config_keys.lane_model: str|None, default None. lane_v5 pre-fit checkpoint path; else $COOPMWM_LANE_MODEL; else the registered head-bias prior. The merged wms.physics.lane_learnable interface wins when present.
where: arm B: binding search_config -> mppi_runtime.plan -> search(config=...)
arm R: job['lane_actions_config'] (plan_client R draw + sumo_verify.install random proposer)
record['search_config']: niche_collect.validate accepts registered lane_* keys

outputs.plan: lane_actions (members x duration_s ints 0 keep/1 left/2 right), lane_envelope ({vid: lane/left/right from lane_feasibility at t0}), lane_predictions (per attempt: member, second_s, action, head, model_logit, model_prob), uses_lane_actions tag; plan id re-digests (lane fields are identity).
outputs.search: out['lane_actions']=True marker + per-finalist uses_lane_actions; topk plans carry their lane fields.
outputs.verification: branch receipt audit['lane_actions'] = {requests, issued, blocked, executed} (additive, only when a plan carries lane actions); per-second sample['lane_requests'] and sample['lane_events'] ({vid: requested/issued/blocked/executed}) on the tape; unbound executor records blocked='unbound' and is never counted as executed.
outputs.bank: imitation pairs carry lane_target {vid: action} (+ lane_target_outcome per vid, or lane_target_outcome_summary from the runtime tick outcome); v2v_intent pairs carry intent_lane_target/intent_lane_mask (plan-relative future lane actions, action encoding 0/1/2); bank_imitation adds the AWR-weighted lane-head CE and reports lane_targets {pairs, head} only when lane data is present.

safety.envelope: decision_envelope = wms.control.lanes.lane_feasibility on the recorded t0 state (all sensed vehicles): mainline 0<->1 only, ramp 2->1 inside [MERGE_S0_M, MERGE_S1_M] only, 1->2 never, SUMO-calibrated target-lane gap rule, dwell (unresolvable = allowed, as a fresh CAV), edge guard. NO hand-set thresholds anywhere; an unresolvable state makes the feature inert (never guesses).
safety.execution: lane actions are only SAMPLED inside the envelope; they are always re-judged at execution by the same model (WM lane machinery / SUMO lane-change safety model). Sampling rate 0.25 is exploration, not safety.
safety.v2v_launch3: no safety check touched; launch_final CPU suite passes unchanged
